prompts.prompt: Wide cinematic film still shot from high in the upper deck of a Las Vegas arena an hour after a world title fight. Rows of empty blue seats, a lit boxing ring far below with a lone corner stool and a coiled roll of hand wrap left on the canvas, house lights half raised. Cold desaturated blue everywhere with one warm pool of light on the canvas. Shot on 35mm, visible grain, deep shadows. No people, no faces, no logos, no text

Two boxers in full silhouette squared up at center ring under a single hard overhead light, photographed from behind and slightly below so no faces are visible. Deep black background, harsh rim light catching shoulders and gloves, one figure flat footed and squared up, the other angled and side on. High contrast near monochrome with a bleed of red spilling in from the ring lights. Cinematic, editorial, dramatic. No faces, no logos, no text

Fine art still life on a dark walnut desk in a dim law office. A stack of stapled court filings, a fountain pen, and three luxury wristwatches laid out in a row beside them like evidence exhibits. A green banker's lamp throws a narrow warm pool of light into surrounding blackness, faint dust in the air. Desaturated, cold shadows, photorealistic, shallow depth of field. No people, no faces, no readable text on the documents, no logos

Noir photograph of an empty press conference dais in a darkened ballroom. Two microphones on a bare table, two chairs pushed back, a plain unmarked cloth backdrop, a single hard spotlight from above leaving the rest of the room in black. Heavy film grain, very high contrast, moody and secretive. No people, no faces, no text, no logos

Documentary photograph of the loading bay of a large London arena the night before a fight. A freight elevator standing open, ring posts and turnbuckle pads stacked on a wooden pallet, wet concrete floor reflecting sodium lights, rain falling outside the open roll up door. Cool blue grey palette with amber highlights, photojournalistic, available light. No people, no faces, no logos, no text

Conceptual editorial photograph of a single boxing glove resting alone at the head of a long boardroom table of polished black glass, mirrored in the tabletop, empty executive chairs receding on both sides, a wall of blank glowing screens behind it casting cold blue light across the room. Wide angle, symmetrical, corporate, cold and slightly ominous. No people, no faces, no text on the screens, no logos

Intimate fine art photograph of a pair of well worn women's boxing gloves hanging from a nail on a weathered gym wall. Laces frayed, leather cracked and creased from years of use, late afternoon sunlight coming through a dusty window and falling across them. Warm amber and umber tones, shallow depth of field, quiet and reverent, photorealistic. No people, no faces, no logos, no text
